facts.statement: The study examined how Alisol B pretreatment affects SH-SY5Y cells exposed to rotenone, focusing on AKT and p38 MAPK signaling.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: Computational methods, including network pharmacology and molecular dynamics simulations, were used to identify potential targets and interactions.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The analysis identified 397 candidate targets, with AKT1 having the highest connectivity in the network.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: While simulations suggested Alisol B could bind to AKT1, they did not prove a direct interaction.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: SH-SY5Y cells were treated with Alisol B before being exposed to rotenone.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: The researchers measured cell metabolic activity, oxidative stress, apoptosis, and protein phosphorylation levels.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: Alisol B treatment partially improved cell health, reduced oxidative stress markers, and lowered apoptosis rates after rotenone exposure.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: The inhibitor MK-2206 was used to test the role of AKT signaling in the observed effects.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: Blocking AKT signaling with MK-2206 reduced the protective effects of Alisol B on cell activity and oxidative stress.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: Alisol B treatment was associated with higher levels of phosphorylated AKT and lower levels of phosphorylated p38 MAPK.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue
